items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And John Sanders and Britt Woodman and myself were the trombones

ctx.x: And I noticed how he would use different musicians in the band. He would take your sound and use it. He would give you certain notes and certain chords, like he would give me certain notes in a chord that he wouldn't give Lawrence or give Tyree or even Britt Woodman or John Sanders, and that's the way he wrote, you see? And that's the reason that he had a lot of different arrangements on one tune in a book. If there was a change in the personnel of the band, that arrangement wouldn't sound the same to him, so he…
